verdict.rationale: Metronome documents its own data export, which sends sandbox and production data directly to a customer's data warehouse, and its list endpoints support pagination, so billing records can be pulled out. The docs do not list which objects the export covers. Nothing shows Metronome stores or can port payment methods; payment collection is delegated to Stripe. Missing for 10: any documented payment-method portability, an explicit list confirming subscriptions, invoices and usage events are all in the export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit export.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave

citations.quote: Metronome can send your sandbox and production data directly to your data warehouse, giving you the flexibility to build reports and dashboards with your favorite data tools.
Metronome provides two URL parameters on all list endpoints for this purpose: limit ... next_page
